segments.thi-ap1:4.1: “Dasakkhattuṃ satakkhattuṃ, dasasatakkhattuṃ satānañca satakkhattuṃ [satāni ca sattakkhattuṃ (sī. ka.)];
segments.thi-ap1:4.3: Devesu upapajjimha, ko vādo mānuse bhave.
segments.thi-ap1:5.3: Sattaratanamahesī [sattaratanassa mahesī (sī. pī.)], itthiratanaṃ ahaṃ bhaviṃ.
segments.thi-ap1:6.3: Dhanañjānī ca khemā ca, ahampi ca tayo janā.
segments.thi-ap1:8.3: Devesu aggataṃ pattā, manussesu tatheva ca.
segments.thi-ap1:9.3: Kassapo nāma gottena, uppajji vadataṃ varo.
segments.thi-ap1:12.3: Datvā dānāni sakkaccaṃ, agāreva vataṃ [agāreva vattaṃ (syā.)] cariṃ.
segments.thi-ap1:18.1: “So hetu ca so pabhavo, tammūlaṃ sāsane khamaṃ [tammūlaṃ sā ca sāsane khanti (sī. pī. ka.)];
segments.thi-ap1:18.3: Paṭhamaṃ taṃ samodhānaṃ, taṃ dhammaratāya nibbānaṃ [nibbutaṃ (syā.)].
segments.thi-ap1:20.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi, mama buddhassa [buddhaseṭṭhassa (sī. syā. ka.)] santike;
segments.thi-ap1:20.3: Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.thi-ap1:22.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ sumedhā bhikkhunī imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
